last.verdict: Investors cheered sales and traffic beating forecasts, shrugging off weaker profit margins.

reasons.label: Sales beat forecasts
reasons.text: Same-store sales rose 2.1%, versus about 1.5% expected and roughly 1% guided.

reasons.label: Customers still returning
reasons.text: Third straight quarter of more transactions, up 0.8%, which suggests the turnaround is holding.

reasons.label: Profit squeeze, expected
reasons.text: Earnings per share slipped to $0.27 from $0.29 as margins fell, but analysts had expected it.

story: Same-store sales went from down 2.5% in late 2025 to up 0.5%, 2.2%, then 2.1%, with traffic recovering. Costs for beef, labor and marketing keep squeezing profits. The stock rose about 6% after hours on the July report but is still down about 20% this year.
